description: Two Private DNS load test runs side by side: publish and query results, and what the control plane and serving fleet did during each. The time range only needs to include both runs.

panels.description: Each measure over the whole of run A and run B, and how B differs from A. Publish times are the worse of the two resolvers. Control-plane and fleet measures cover only the time each run was going, plus up to 30 seconds after it ended. They are worked out over the whole time range before being cut to each run, so keep the range to the hours around the two runs. A blank cell means the run reported no such series, for example on a build without that metric.

panels.description: Average CPU of each serving member type and container while each run was going, summed over its pods.

targets.expr: label_join(avg_over_time(((sum by (member, container) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"ns-.*",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[30s]), "member", "$1", "pod", "internal-dns-(.+)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"))) and on () max(idns_perf_run{run="$run_a"} offset 30s))[$__range:30s]), "workload", " ", "member", "container")

label_join(avg_over_time(((sum by (member, container) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"ns-.*",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[30s]), "member", "$1", "pod", "internal-dns-(.+)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"))) and on () max(idns_perf_run{run="$run_b"} offset 30s))[$__range:30s]), "workload", " ", "member", "container")
